title: India's GI ecosystem gathers momentum
summary: GI tags can lift rural artisan incomes up to 30%, as India races toward 10,000 registrations by 2030.

blocks.content: GI tags can lift rural artisan incomes up to 30%, as India races toward 10,000 registrations by 2030.
